 Follow ‘Landman’ Films at TCU Football Game as Ali Larter Turns Heads in Purple Dress
 Rachel Schneider Mon, November 16, 2026 at 3:30 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. ‘Landman’ Films at TCU Football Game as Ali Larter Turns Heads in Purple Dress TCU fans got a little Hollywood with their football Saturday.
 Landman filmed at the TCU football game against Kansas State on Saturday, Nov. 14, shooting Season 3 scenes around Amon G. Carter Stadium while the Horned Frogs won 20-10, according to the Fort Worth Star-Telegram. 
 The Taylor Sheridan drama brought several of its stars to Fort Worth, and Ali Larter was one of the biggest stars there.
 Ali Larter Dresses in TCU Colors
 Larter, who plays Angela Norris, was seen filming scenes from a suite during the game. Video from the day shows her in a fitted purple-and-white dress in TCU colors, and she appeared to be holding a cell phone as though on a FaceTime call. If you're a fan of the series, you can probably deduce Billy Bob Thornton's Tommy Norris was on the receiving end of the call, more than likely finding himself on the hook for another elaborate dinner plan or purchase.
 Stefania Spampinato, who plays Bella Morrell, was also seen filming a scene alongside Larter.
 Michelle Randolph Back in Her Cheer Uniform
 The game also brought back one of Season 2's biggest storylines. Michelle Randolph, who plays Angela's daughter Ainsley, filmed on the field in a TCU cheerleader uniform.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In Season 2, Ainsley left West Texas for TCU, joined the cheer squad and clashed with her roommate, Paigyn, a team trainer, before the two became friends in the finale. Bobbi Salvor Menuez, who plays Paigyn, was also on set Saturday in TCU trainer gear.
 About 30 real TCU cheerleaders were expected to take part in the production .
 Randolph had some famous support on the sideline. Her boyfriend, Glen Powell , was spotted cheering her on and snapping photos while the cameras rolled.
 When Does 'Landman' Season 3 Come Out?
 Production on Season 3 began in Fort Worth in late September, and the crew filmed on TCU's campus earlier this fall.
 Paramount+ hasn't announced a premiere date, but season 3 isn't expected until 2027 after production delays pushed it out of its usual fall release .
 Advertisement Advertisement Seasons 1 and 2 of Landman , starring Billy Bob Thornton, Ali Larter, Michelle Randolph, and Demi Moore, are streaming on Paramount+.
